inputs.text: A parliamentary briefing on 24 March 2026 has linked Terry Pheto to an alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission funding scandal under SIU investigation. That is not proof of guilt, but public money is entrusted for the public good—not to be shielded by celebrity status or political convenience. The investigation should establish the facts, and anyone found responsible should face proper consequences. A society that expects ordinary citizens to answer for their actions must apply the same standard to the well-connected.
